title: RNADyn: A Benchmark for Generating and Understanding RNA Dynamics
why_read: A solid but niche benchmark and model for RNA molecular dynamics that will mainly interest computational biology and structural biology researchers.
analysis: RNADynBench provides thousands of curated molecular dynamics simulation trajectories for RNA, addressing a lack of standardized data in this subfield. The accompanying model, RNADynNet, unifies trajectory generation and dynamics prediction from a single structural snapshot using a shared architecture. This is a specialized contribution mostly relevant to people working on RNA structure or drug design rather than general software engineers.
